Why This Trip

Built from what actually works for women's milestone travel.

We studied the best milestone-celebration and adventure trips operating in Costa Rica today — and kept only what earns its place: real variety, a real party, and room for every traveler in the group.

How we mark the moment, start to finish: an opening circle on Day 1 where she names what she's carrying into the week, a milestone toast on Day 2, the full Milestone Celebration Night on Day 3, and a bonfire circle with a keepsake token to take home on Day 4. It builds the whole trip, not just one night.

Adventure & celebration, same trip

Every day pairs a high-adrenaline activity with a laid-back one — nobody has to choose between the zip-line and the pool bar.

One party, not an afterthought

Night three is built around a full-on Milestone Celebration Night — DJ, dance floor and a private-party celebration hosted by Valery, an experienced host for milestone nights like this — the electric centerpiece of the trip, not a bolt-on dinner.

Three ways to stay

From a private-bedroom resort stay to a full villa buyout in Punta Leona — one intimate departure at a time, capped at 6–10 guests, priced for however her circle wants to gather.

Nothing left to plan

Sneha Coastlines handles booking, transport and logistics end to end — so all your circle has to do is show up ready to celebrate.

The Journey

Five days, three places, one milestone.

Adapted from Sneha Coastlines' proven South Costa Rica route — the same trusted drivers, stays and guides, reshaped around a celebration.

01
San José · Heredia Province

Arrival & the Opening Circle

VIP pickup at SJO and private transfer to a stylish San José stay with pool, gym and a lounge built for a group that just landed. Before dinner, the group gathers for a short welcome circle led by Valery — each woman names the milestone she's carrying into the week. In the days before you arrive, Valery already reaches out to the guest of honor directly, so this circle — and the toast on the Milestone Celebration Night — is built around her actual story, not a generic script. The evening closes with a celebration dinner at one of San José's better tables, with a toast to kick things off properly.

Private airport transferOpening circle with ValeryOptional: San José nightlife
02
Jacó Beach · Puntarenas Province

Arrival on the Pacific & a Sunset Pool Party

A scenic Pacific-coast drive, with a stop for a traditional Costa Rican breakfast en route. Check into whichever tier the group has chosen — from resort villas to a private beachfront home — then kick the celebration off with a sunset pool party right on the beach: music, cocktails and a DJ, building to the first milestone toast of the trip.

Scenic coastal driveSunset pool partyOptional: casino evening
03
Jacó

Choose Her Adventure — Then, the Milestone Celebration Night

Mornings start with an optional sunrise paddleboard session on the beach. From there, an à la carte activity menu lets every energy level join the same departure: ziplining, ATV touring, parasailing, surfing or horseback riding for the adventurous; a guided Carara National Park walk or a lazy pool day for those who'd rather ease in. As the sun drops, the whole group gathers for the trip's signature evening — see below.

Optional: zipline, ATV, surf, horsebackOptional: Carara National Park & pool dayMilestone Celebration NightOptional: private boat celebration
04
Manuel Antonio National Park · Quepos

Wildlife by Day, Gratitude by Firelight

A guided walk through Manuel Antonio's white-sand coves in search of sloths, monkeys and birdlife, with an optional afternoon on the water — a catamaran cruise with snorkeling and sunset dolphins, a trip to Nauyaca Waterfalls, or a mangrove tour. As evening falls, the group closes the circle around a beach bonfire: a milestone toast guided by Valery, and a keepsake token for each woman to carry home. Farewell dinner follows.

Guided national park tourOptional: catamaran, waterfalls or mangrovesBonfire milestone circle
05
Jacó → San José International Airport

Carry the Glow Home

An unhurried final morning together, then a private, door-to-door transfer back to SJO, with breakfast or lunch options along the way. A closing send-off from the team sees every guest off with more than a suitcase.

Private airport transferClosing send-off
The Signature Moment

Night three: the Milestone Celebration Night.

This is what makes our tours special: we throw this night ourselves. It's built as a private party for your group — DJ, dance floor, club-style energy — a celebration built around the reason everyone is really here.

"Not just a dinner. Her party, thrown exactly right."

What's Included

  • A private candlelit dinner with custom catering, styled for the group
  • DJ and an open dance floor under the stars — a private-party, club-style celebration just for your group
  • A high-energy closing set guided by Valery, an experienced host for milestone celebrations — surprise send-off, glow effects, or a group dance-off, matched to the group's energy
  • A shared toast, with each woman's milestone named aloud — and a dedicated moment built specifically around the guest of honor, so she's never just one more name in the group toast
  • Option to take it out to sea — a private boat charter on the ocean with DJ, drinks and cake, for groups who'd rather celebrate on the water

Included in every single tier

The only difference between the three tiers above is where you lay your head at night — everything below comes standard, no matter which one your group picks.

  • All ground transport & transfers
  • The Milestone Celebration Night
  • Daily guide & group activities
  • Sunset beach pool parties
  • Water, juices, energy drinks & snacks, all trip long
  • Professional photography & videography of the whole trip — drone shots included, because your milestone deserves an aerial view too. We'll turn it all into cool reels you'll actually want to post
  • Bonus talent, free of charge: Valery is also a trained nail artist and hairstylist, so don't be shocked if your mani and your blowout end up looking more red-carpet than road-trip by the time she's done with you
  • Even more bonus talent: Valery and our drivers moonlight as trained bartenders, so when it's cocktail hour, expect something shaken, stirred and suspiciously well-made

The fine print, made easy: flights, travel insurance, individual excursion tickets, dinners (outside of our big Milestone Celebration Night) and alcohol aren't included in any tier. But here's the fun part — once your group's exact itinerary is locked in, we'll help you add on excursions and meals for an extra cost, tailored just for your crew. And you won't lift a finger to arrange any of it: Valery personally books every excursion, restaurant and venue for the group, so all you have to do is show up ready to celebrate. A deposit-plus-payment-plan option will be offered at booking, in line with how comparable Costa Rica group trips are typically sold.

Your Hosts

Who's holding the trip.

Sneha Coastlines handles every booking and detail behind the scenes — planning, execution and door-to-door service, start to finish. Two of our team lead the experience itself: Valery is on the ground with your group for all five days, and Melvin keeps everything running smoothly in English and Spanish before, during and after the trip.

Valery

Guide, Companion & Concierge · Photographer, Videographer & Gastronomy Guide

Valery is with the group every step of the way — all five days, alongside our drivers, from the airport pickup to the final send-off. She's part guide, part concierge, part hype woman: stocking snacks and water, running the soundtrack as the group's unofficial DJ, and walking everyone to activities, restaurants and the best local food along the way. She pulls together the celebrations and get-togethers that make the trip feel personal, handles local translation and anything else the group needs day to day, and — as a trained photographer and videographer — captures it all as it happens, editing the photos into reels and sending them to the whole group before you're even home.

Melvin

Logistics, Planning & Bilingual Support (English & Spanish)

Melvin doesn't travel with the group — he's the one making sure everything runs smoothly behind the scenes. Fluent in English and Spanish, he works alongside Valery on trip planning and logistics, sorting every detail before departure, then stays on call throughout the trip for whatever the group needs, online or offline, day or night.

You're in Good Hands

Real support, from booking to the last night.

This trip runs the way we'd want it to run for our own sisters and friends — vetted, looked-after, and never improvised.

Vetted drivers & partners

Every driver, stay and venue on this route is one Sneha Coastlines already works with and trusts — this isn't our first group on these roads.

24/7 support, in English

Melvin is reachable by WhatsApp around the clock for the length of your trip — before, during and after — for anything from a lost bag to a change of plans.

A plan if something goes wrong

Our team knows the nearest clinics and hospitals along the route, and Valery and Melvin coordinate directly with local care if it's ever needed. We strongly encourage every guest to travel with insurance, and Melvin can point you to a good option.

Close by, but never in the way

Good to Know

Frequently asked questions.

Who is this trip for?+
Women marking any kind of milestone — a birthday, a retirement, a remission, an empty nest, a new chapter. Mother-daughter duos and full friend groups are welcome; most departures run 6–10 guests.
How is the Milestone Night personalized for the guest of honor?+
In the days before the trip, Valery reaches out directly to the woman being celebrated to learn her story and what this milestone actually means to her. That's what shapes the opening circle on Day 1 and the toast on the Milestone Celebration Night, plus her own dedicated moment that night — so it's never a generic toast, it's specifically about her.
Can our group mix stay tiers?+
Yes. The three stay tiers share the same itinerary, guide and Milestone Celebration Night — guests simply choose the accommodation that fits their budget, and the whole group still celebrates together each evening.
I've heard Costa Rica is hot and humid — won't the activities be exhausting?+
We pace every day around your specific group — nobody is ever pushed into an activity she's not comfortable with, and every adventure activity on Days 2–4 has a slower, optional alternative built right in. Valery and our drivers are with you throughout, always keeping water and electrolytes on hand, so everyone stays hydrated, comfortable and safe no matter how the afternoon heat is running.
What's the safety and support plan?+
Every driver on this route is one we already know and trust, and Melvin is reachable around the clock for the length of the trip. Valery and our drivers stay close to the group throughout — never far if you need something — while still giving your circle real privacy and space. Our team also knows the nearest clinics and hospitals along the way, and we strongly recommend every guest travel with insurance — ask Melvin for a recommendation when you book.
You're a newer agency — how do we know you can pull this off?+
Fair question, and it's less new than it looks. We've spent almost three years organizing group trips through Costa Rica for our own friends and family, and this tour brings that personal experience together with local partners who've been doing it even longer. Being a young brand gives us energy a lot of bigger operators lose along the way — but it doesn't mean we're careless: we run nine vetted vehicles across the San José area, with background-checked drivers who've been on these same roads for the last two years.
Why isn't this trip advertised online or on social media?+
Because we're keeping it exclusive, on purpose. This tour is shared only through a close circle of friends and partners we trust — which is exactly how it reached you. That personal thread of trust is part of the experience, not a gap in our marketing.
Is there a payment plan, and what if plans change?+
Yes — Sneha Coastlines offers a deposit plus installment plan at booking. Deposits are refundable up to a set window before departure; reach out on the details below and the team will walk your group through the exact terms and dates.
